searchText: Hey <@&1417820113981145228>, if there's anything you'd like to bring up at ACDT today, please leave a comment here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2144 I've started looking at graffiti watermarks slightly differently, because i can report percentages as 'percentage of total mainnet blocks' for each client based on detected watermarks... Over the last few days it looks like this: ``` Detection Summary (Last 4 Days) -------------------------------------------------- Total blocks: 28,660 Blocks with detected client: 14,029 Blocks without detected client: 14,631 Detected percentage: 48.95% Undetected percentage: 51.05% Client Distribution (Last 4 Days) -------------------------------------------------- Total blocks (last 4 days): 28,660 Consensus Clients: Client | Count | Percentage ------------------------------------------------------- Lighthouse | 7,465 | 26.05% Teku | 3,158 | 11.02% Prysm | 3,120 | 10.89% Lodestar | 169 | 0.59% Grandine | 64 | 0.22% Execution Clients: Client | Count | Percentage ------------------------------------------------------- go-ethereum | 6,423 | 22.41% Nethermind | 4,937 | 17.23% Besu | 2,358 | 8.23% Reth | 281 | 0.98% Erigon | 23 | 0.08% ``` Now that prysm is reporting, we've got nearly 50% coverage of mainnet blocks, and it's probably fair to make rough comparisons like 'prysm and teku are similar network percentages', and 'lighthouse is a significantly higher percentage than teku or prysm'. Actual percentages are harder to derive, but its starting to become more interesting, so figured it's worth sharing.

excerpts.content:
I've started looking at graffiti watermarks slightly differently, because i can report percentages as 'percentage of total mainnet blocks' for each client based on detected watermarks...

Over the last few days it looks like this:
```
Detection Summary (Last 4 Days)
--------------------------------------------------
Total blocks:                         28,660
Blocks with detected client:          14,029
Blocks without detected client:       14,631
Detected percentage:                  48.95%
Undetected percentage:                51.05%

Client Distribution (Last 4 Days)
--------------------------------------------------
Total blocks (last 4 days): 28,660

Consensus Clients:
  Client                    |           Count | Percentage
  -------------------------------------------------------
  Lighthouse                |           7,465 |     26.05%
  Teku                      |           3,158 |     11.02%
  Prysm                     |           3,120 |     10.89%
  Lodestar                  |             169 |      0.59%
  Grandine                  |              64 |      0.22%

Execution Clients:
  Client                    |           Count | Percentage
  -------------------------------------------------------
  go-ethereum               |           6,423 |     22.41%
  Nethermind                |           4,937 |     17.23%
  Besu                      |           2,358 |      8.23%
  Reth                      |             281 |      0.98%
  Erigon                    |              23 |      0.08%

```
Now that prysm is reporting, we've got nearly 50% coverage of mainnet blocks, and it's probably fair to make rough comparisons like 'prysm and teku are similar network percentages', and 'lighthouse is a significantly higher percentage than teku or prysm'.

Actual percentages are harder to derive, but its starting to become more interesting, so figured it's worth sharing.
